description: The files the workspace has uploaded for its reports, newest first: each with its sha256 (what a block names), name, type, size and, for a picture or a video, its size in pixels and length. Pass nextBeforeId as before for the next page.

before.description: The nextBeforeId of the previous page.

limit.description: The most files to list; the app's own page size when absent.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_report_files
title: List the files uploaded for reports
